6 of 8 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Quarterly Financial Results Review

Lester Decker presented the Quarterly Financial Results Review for committee review. The analysis, prepared by ACPWB engagement team, covered 131 employee records across 13 organizational units. Discussion focused on variance from prior-year benchmarks and alignment with the Human Services Nonprofits peer group. Members raised questions regarding methodology and timeline for implementation. Lester Decker noted that all supporting documentation is available as Exhibit A in the meeting materials.

Motion

To rescind: RESOLVED, that the Environmental Compliance Committee approves the selection of Oswald Firth Advisory as the vendor for the Quarterly Financial Results Review and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Kevin Acar  •  Seconded: Lester Decker
Vote: 4 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Regional Business Review: Americas

The committee reviewed the quarterly performance metrics related to the Regional Business Review: Americas. Angelica Bankole reported that all KPIs were within the target range, with the exception of a 20% shortfall in the 13 region. A plan to address this regional variance was requested for the next meeting.

Motion

To approve for leveraging: RESOLVED, that the Environmental Compliance Committee approves the formation of a new subsidiary, Oswald Firth Advisory, to pursue the Regional Business Review: Americas.

Moved: Ming Burt  •  Seconded: Glen Keys
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Regional Business Review: APAC

The regular quarterly review of the Regional Business Review: APAC was led by Raffaele Bassey. The data presented in Exhibit C showed performance to be on track with the 2022 operating plan. The committee acknowledged the positive progress and accepted the report as filed, with no further action required at this time.
